What is running, queued, parked or done is jobs.py status (lanes, pins, peaks), never a fact or hand-over prose; a measurement from a job cites its record jobs/done/<id>.json. Add jobs with jobs.py add (pinned to HEAD by default), reorder with first <id>, re-estimate a pending or running job with estimate <id> <minutes> (history kept in estimates), settle a parked chain with unpark and verdict <id> pass|fail; python scripts/dashboard.py serves a read-only page (health, sessions, jobs, lanes) on http://127.0.0.1:8766.
